name: Cubature
nameStatus: Final fork name; GitHub repository orthrus-research/Cubature, a fork of OpenCubicChunks/CubicChunks
reason: Cubature owns cubic scheduling, lighting, lifetime, storage and DH runtime compatibility/optimization patches; Riven owns generated content
scope: Exact Cubature commit; compatibility IDs, APIs, packets and world formats retained.

qualification.status: Built from this clean Cubature commit as Java 25 bytecode; all 416 Java sources in the sources artifact match the commit, and core (454) and matching-artifact lab (100) tests pass on Java 26. Native lifecycle and flight captures passed in BASELINE with four DH workers per JVM, on 8 GiB ZGC and on the shipping G1 profile (8 GiB, 4 MB regions, 50 ms pause target, concurrent explicit collections), which newly prepared lab instances now use.
qualification.contents: Bounded native generation, regional preparation, previews, storage and DH delivery; host-owned build pools available before biome-provider construction and preserved after adoption; save-level derived-data directory requests; cached cube classification and surface bands, used to install EMPTY cubes without generation and to order delivery visible-first; early initial light and surface tracking for empty sky cubes; retained-column preparation and urgent held teleports; exclusive server-thread phase accounting, with block ticks and player-map bookkeeping separated (the lab alone wraps vanilla call sites for network and tick-event phases), and client native-capture counters; a random-tick scan skipped while only spectators are present; regional preparation around spawn while no player is present; flushes that write each region's backlog in one batch, storage compression on reused deflaters and bounded workers, and regenerable empty cubes left unsaved; chunk-mesh builders that start with small layer buffers; a public random-tick listener API on the cubic pass; no compatibility code for mods or platforms outside the runtime (Demonica and its Celeritas kept). Compatibility IDs, packets, save formats and the upstream DH binary are preserved.
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
qualification.knownExistingWarning: Arrival, flight and save were last measured on the previous pin: arrival first observed 70-77 s after target-view capture start; startup ticks up to 546 ms; an explicit save/purge/flush tick of 1.861 s; on this pin the post-flight save/purge/flush tick measured 0.61 s. Refmap warnings and connection resets during controlled client shutdown remain. Client rendering and held maps remain unqualified.
